Who will be the next Chief Minister of — , , , , or someone else? What will be the future of Prasad Yadav and his party’s politics? The answers to all these questions will be revealed in the 2025.
But before that, Lallantop went on the ground to gauge the pulse of the people of Bihar. In this new series, ‘Hum Bihar Ke Log’, the team spent a day with people from different age groups, classes, and communities to understand their lives.
